title: No Move to Spare
setup: Your king is stranded on h5 with Black's queen, rook and bishop all in range — one more black move and it is over.
hint: Defending loses. Count your own checks instead and find the one Black cannot answer twice.
explanation:
## The Idea

Black threatens mate on h6, so there is no time to defend. {{Rb7+}} checks first and leaves two answers. {{Be7}} blocks, and {{Rxe7#}} takes the blocker. {{Qxb7}} takes the rook instead, and {{Qg6#}} mates.

When both kings are in danger, the side giving check sets the move order.
